claims.statement: Missed appointments waste paid clinical capacity; OECD-described trials used SMS reminders and easier cancellation to reduce friction, supporting a measurable utilization-loss mechanism though not Polish private-clinic economics.
A clinic manager controlling appointment revenue is the plausible payer for recovered slots; Polish willingness to pay remains unknown.

commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: The rail combines risk scoring, one-tap cancellation, waitlist refill and recovered-revenue attribution; basic reminder SMS is readily bundled.
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own clinic subscriptions; clinics retain patient relationships and lawful treatment records.

fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Monthly platform fee prepaid plus performance fee after reconciled attendance.
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Integration and consent-template setup estimated at 10-30 hours per clinic.
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: GDPR health-data controls, legal review, security and insurance estimated at 20,000 PLN monthly.
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Monthly fee plus percentage of verified recovered appointment revenue.
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: SMS/WhatsApp, payment processing, integration and support.

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Scheduling vendors can add waitlist refill; defend with vendor-neutral attribution and outcome pricing.
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: A booked clinical slot goes unused or is refilled; clinic revenue from the recovered appointment is the measurable paid event.
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: No-show rate or cancellation gaps exceed management target.
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Monthly based on recovered slots and ongoing schedule volume.

contrary_evidence: Existing practice software already sends reminders.
Health-data processing and automated scoring raise compliance and trust burdens.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Unknown; proposed clinic workflow integration and data-processing agreement are unsigned.
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Start with daily CSV exports containing minimum necessary pseudonymized scheduling data and one clinic-managed messaging channel.
critical_control_point.current_owner: Clinics control patient relationships and schedules; practice-management vendors control integrations.
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own clinic subscriptions; clinics retain patient relationships and lawful treatment records.
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: A medical-student relationship provides domain conversation only, not clinic access, patient data or professional authorization.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: The founder would control refill logic; clinics control patient contact and care decisions.
critical_control_point.subject: Cancelled-slot refill transaction rail

economics.acquisition_route: Run a four-week clinic-managed CSV pilot, measure incremental filled slots against baseline, then seek scheduling integrations.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: 300 clinics at 1,800 PLN monthly plus 500 PLN average performance fees yields 8.3M PLN ARR; at 20% owner earnings and 4x value, a 70% stake could exceed 5M PLN in years 7-10. Integration CAC and causality are unknown.
economics.founder_time: 15-20 hours weekly; privacy and integration specialists contracted.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Subscription and performance fees less messaging, integrations and direct support; target 72%.
economics.payback: One or two recovered specialist visits monthly should cover a 1,000-2,500 PLN fee; validate by specialty.
economics.pricing: 900-2,500 PLN monthly plus 5-10% of verified recovered revenue.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every clinic schedule generates cancellations and waitlist opportunities.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned specialty-level cancellation and refill-response models.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Clinic pays monthly and on verified recovered appointment revenue.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: High no-show rate or recurring unfilled cancellations.

founder_fit: Girlfriend offers general medical context but no protected access
Can validate without becoming a public-facing clinician

structural_signature.commercial_model_descriptor: outcome priced cancelled slot refill rail
structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: proposed cancellation to waitlist matching event

thesis: Charge on the recovered appointment event by connecting easy cancellation, waitlist matching and attendance attribution.
title: Clinic No-Show Fill Rail
